name: Savory Tomato-Chive French Toast with Apple, Feta & Pumpkin Seed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 Gala apple
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
½ small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, tomato sauce, cornstarch, and spices in a baking dish; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 eggs
½ (8 oz) can tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp cornstarch
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp paprika
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp onion powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place bread slices in the dish with the egg batter; turn the slices, making sure both sides are soaked through.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, transfer soaked bread to the skillet and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp honey
½ tsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter and core the apple, then thinly slice each quarter; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add spring mix, feta, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
⅛ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Divide French toast between plates; top with butter and chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
